G0_witness: Original A AND C AND D, unchanged; G0_eligible=A AND C is retained separately.
G1_pass: Exactly original all_direct_eligible: all 12 measured direct renderings valid/correct in all 8 histories AND target native-final/no-op references correct. G1_witness=G1_pass AND original D.
G2a_pass: G1_pass AND both non-target SAME/BOTH/EITHER functions on the target pair valid/correct in all eight histories, using the target answer-code draw. Logical sufficiency of the two checks is INTENTIONAL.
G2b_pass: G1_pass AND all three functions on each of the OTHER TWO addressed actor pairs valid/correct in all eight histories using the target draw: six distinct semantic checks.
M: At least one valid target-disagreeing unordered history pair with equal actual changed-address count and equal len(saved context.prefix_ids). Matching is within a model/condition/seed. No pair IDs are hard-coded.
both_pass: G2a_pass AND G2b_pass; neither gate is substituted for the other.
cross_code_M: The SAME allowed pair must disagree in the SAME semantic direction in both target-code realizations. Require original eligibility in both draws. Count semantic targets once, using the draw-0 representative.
cross_code_certification: For each semantic target, require the respective primary certification under both target draws, including both draws of native/no-op references. Two code realizations are interface robustness, not two semantic facts.
denominators: Primary 18 coded targets/root/seed (1152 per condition). Cross-code 9 semantic targets/root/seed (576 per condition). Learned groups average seeds within roots; group root counts are larger-search-budget two-seed unions.
disagreement_retention_ceiling: Number of original G0 witnesses retaining at least one matched valid disagreeing pair. Cross-code version uses common-pair same-direction original witnesses on the semantic denominator.
manual_audit: After automated results, review every distinct surviving design root if feasible. Always include every strong surviving opportunity, plus deterministic representatives of every surviving root/model/condition when many coded opportunities repeat. State exact coverage; no manual exclusions based on impressiveness.
pair_availability_ceiling: Number of fixed target opportunities having at least one count+prefix-length matched pair, regardless of prediction.
prior_exposure: The earlier requested audit (different attachment) was completed before the live goal replacement was discovered. Its both-code same-pair and whole-battery results were already inspected. This explicitly user-directed post-hoc revision fixes G2a/G2b by Boolean structure, never by surviving IDs/margins/model/method/seed. Do not claim fresh outcome blinding.
request: User-revised CPU AUDIT: G2a logical consistency and G2b cross-pair propagation
statistics: Counts, root counts, retention/G0, retention/disagreement ceiling, fixed rates and gate-conditional rates; no new intervals or confirmatory tests.
strong: Reuse original strong flag exactly; M-restricted strong ALSO requires the SAME allowed pair to span >=.95 and <=.05 correct-label probabilities. Cross-code strong requires the same pair to satisfy both codes, with same semantic direction.
